cim_eredeti: Is the AI boom reminiscent of the 1870s railroad boom, bust and ensuing financial crisis?
szoveg_eredeti:
With the artificial intelligence boom, private capital is flooding into building new technology infrastructure. This also happened with railroad construction in the 1870s, a boom that ended in a bust that created a financial crisis.

Liaquat Ahamed, an economist, financial historian sees parallels in these two building booms, and it makes him nervous.

Here & Now's Scott Tong speaks with Ahamed, whose latest book is "1873: The First Great Depression and the Making of the Modern World."

This segment airs on November 17, 2026. Audio will be available after the broadcast.
